# Mapping Africa: crop field boundary labels for Africa, 2017-2023

Mapping Africa field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Agricultural Impacts Research Group, Clark University. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna_labels/latest/lacuna_labels.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna_labels/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: rscore, admin:country_code, id, label_category, assignment_id, metrics:area, geometry, site, label_class, determination:datetime, qscore, labeller, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna_labels/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna_labels/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna_labels/collection.json
